fullContentHtml:
RRB NTPC Undergraduate Recruitment 2026 Apply Online — Overview & Official Information

Railway Recruitment Board (RRB / RRC) has announced the recruitment drive for RRB NTPC Undergraduate (2026). Interested and eligible candidates seeking central and state government employment can check vacancy details, educational qualifications, age limit, application fee, and selection criteria. The online application process must be completed through the official portal https://rrbcdg.gov.in before the stipulated deadline.

Important Dates Schedule

  • Official Notification Release : Available on Official Portal (RRB)
  • Application Online Form Start : As per Official Schedule 2026
  • Last Date to Apply Online : Information will be updated after the official notification.
  • Last Date for Fee Payment : To be notified soon
  • Admit Card Release Date : 7-10 Days Before Written Examination
  • Written Exam Date : Check official schedule on RRB portal

Application Fee Details

  • General / OBC / EWS Candidates : As specified in official notification
  • SC / ST / PwD Candidates : Exempted / Concessional as per rules
  • All Category Female Candidates : As per commission guidelines
  • Mode of Payment : Online via Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking, or UPI.

Age Limit & Eligibility Criteria

  • Minimum Age Requirement : 18 Years (Post Wise)
  • Maximum Age Limit : 27 to 32 Years (Subject to Post & Category)
  • Age Relaxation : Applicable for SC/ST (5 Years), OBC (3 Years), PwD, and Ex-Servicemen as per Government of India / State Government rules.
  • Age Calculation Reference Date : Detailed in the official advertisement PDF.

Vacancy Details & Qualification Matrix

Post Name Total Posts Eligibility Criteria
RRB NTPC Undergraduate (2026) Refer to Official Notification PDF Bachelor's Degree / 10+2 / Matriculation or equivalent qualification from a recognized University / Board in India.

Selection Process Stages

  • Stage 1: Preliminary Written Examination (Computer-Based Test / OMR-Based)
  • Stage 2: Mains Examination / Tier-II Exam (where applicable)
  • Stage 3: Physical Endurance & Measurement Test (for Police/Defence/Forest posts)
  • Stage 4: Skill Test / Typing Speed Test / Stenography (Post-specific)
  • Stage 5: Document Verification (DV) & Biometric Matching
  • Stage 6: Final Medical Examination & Merit List Allotment

Exam Pattern & Scheme of Examination

  • Exam Mode: Computer Based Test (CBT) / Offline OMR Mode
  • Question Type: Multiple Choice Objective Questions (MCQs)
  • Core Subjects: General Intelligence & Reasoning, General Awareness, Quantitative Aptitude, English/Hindi Language Comprehension
  • Negative Marking: 0.25 to 0.33 marks deduction for each incorrect response (as per official guidelines)

Salary & Pay Scale Information

Pay Scale: 7th Central Pay Commission (CPC) / State Pay Matrix level corresponding to the post, along with DA, HRA, and admissible allowances.

How to Apply Online for RRB NTPC Undergraduate Recruitment 2026 Apply Online

  1. Visit the official portal of Railway Recruitment Board (RRB / RRC) at https://rrbcdg.gov.in.
  2. Locate and click on the "Recruitment / Notices" section on the homepage.
  3. Find the link for "RRB NTPC Undergraduate Recruitment 2026 Apply Online" and open the official notification PDF. Read all eligibility norms carefully.
  4. Click on the "New Registration / Apply Online" button. Provide your basic details, mobile number, and valid email address.
  5. Fill in the educational qualifications, category details, and personal information accurately as per your matriculation certificate.
  6. Upload clear scanned copies of your recent passport-size photograph, signature, and required documents in the prescribed format.
  7. Pay the required application fee through online banking, credit/debit card, or UPI.
  8. Verify all entered information in the application preview, submit the form, and download/print the confirmation receipt for future reference.

Important Documents Required for Verification

  • Matriculation (10th) Board Certificate & Marksheet (as proof of Date of Birth and Father's/Mother's name).
  • Intermediate (12th) Marksheet & Passing Certificate (if applicable).
  • Graduation / Diploma / Post-Graduation Degree & Semester-wise Marksheets.
  • Valid Government Photo Identity Card (Aadhaar Card / Voter ID Card / PAN Card / Passport).
  • Category / Caste Certificate (SC / ST / OBC Non-Creamy Layer / EWS) in prescribed Central or State format.
  • Domicile / Residence Certificate issued by the competent revenue authority.
  • Recent color passport-size photographs matching the online application upload.
  • Disability Certificate (PwD) / No Objection Certificate (NOC for serving government employees), if applicable.

Important Official Links

  • Apply Online (Registration / Login)
  • Download Official Notification PDF (RRB)
  • Official Portal (Railway Recruitment Board (RRB / RRC))

The official examination portal is https://rrbcdg.gov.in. Candidates should always verify notices directly from official sources.

Q: What is the selection process for RRB NTPC Undergraduate?

The selection process typically includes a written examination (CBT/OMR), document verification, and medical examination as per official guidelines.
